purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
The three relation-ledger edges remain candidate rather than canonical.
Fulfilment, order, inventory, shipment, service, invoice, payment, return and refund identities remain separate.
Commitment, allocation, dispatch, delivery, receipt, inspection, acceptance, completion and discharge states and times remain distinct.
Quantity, condition, authority, jurisdiction, privacy and interoperability qualifiers remain explicit.
Every external mapping is version-pinned, profile-qualified and loss-declaring.
audit_findings: The obligation-performance boundary is coherent and does not absorb neighboring order, inventory, logistics, service, billing or reverse-flow masters.
Promised subjects, units, quantities, conditions, substitutions and party roles remain separately attributable.
Dispatch, delivery, receipt, inspection, acceptance, completion and discharge are not treated as equivalent.
Exceptions, remedies, corrections and cancellations preserve prior evidence and independent external effects.
Autonomous allocation, dispatch, activation, acceptance, discharge, billing, payment, return, refund, disclosure and disposition remain prohibited.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
